selection_rule: Highest balanced accuracy among all 36 layers on phase2B, ties choose earlier layer. This uses 2B as development for the new 2C check; not an unbiased 2B peak estimate.
confirmation: Report the already trained 2A readout at this selected layer on the new 2C no-backup and backup strata. Do not choose a new layer using 2C scores.
reason: Full curves show better source transfer in middle layers than final layer; a final-layer failure cannot establish absence of the information.
